description: Search published THE COOP articles, approved glossary terms, provider and media profiles and industry events by meaning and keywords. Use for questions and discovery; use search_providers for a name/category directory browse. Returns relevance-ranked results, one passage per record with slug, canonical URL, dates and match_strength (text relevance, not answer confidence). Limited to the top matches, without pagination; empty results mean no matches. Use get_article / explain_term / get_provider / get_event to check full records and sources.

limit.description: Maximum distinct records, from 1 to 20 (default 8). Returns the top relevance-ranked matches; no page parameter or exhaustive total.

provider_category.description: Exact provider category; set types to ["provider"].

query.description: Natural-language question or keywords, e.g. "payment orchestration for UK operators"

review_status.description: Restrict to provider/media profiles with this review status; also set types to ["provider"]. desk-reviewed means editorially reviewed, not independent verification of every fact; research-candidate means awaiting that review.

supplier_category.description: Deprecated alias of provider_category; if both are supplied they must match. Match this provider category exactly; also set types to ["provider"]. Use media for publication profiles; combine with review_status to narrow further.

topic.description: Match this article topic exactly; also set types to ["article"]. Combining with provider filters yields no matches.

types.description: Record types to search. provider is canonical; supplier is a deprecated alias. Omit or pass an empty array for all enabled types. Filters combine with AND; a filter for one record type excludes other types.

name: search
title: Search THE COOP
